description: Stop gifts from the sender of one of the signed-in person’s gifts. Their gifts no longer show up here, and Befana won’t start new gifts from them to this person. The sender isn’t told. save:"preview" (default) first; save:"save" blocks.

gift_id.description: A gift from the person to block, from my_gifts

save.description: preview (default) shows what would happen and keeps nothing; save does it. Only use save after the person said yes to the preview.

name: block_sender
title: Block a sender
